findings.title: No Programmatic API — Form-Based UI Only
findings.description: The application exposes only a Struts 1.3 form-submission-based web UI at /loan. No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface exists. Integration requires direct database access or UI automation.
findings.gap: No programmatic API exists. The only interface is JSP form pages rendered by a Struts Action.
findings.recommendation: Expose the loan calculation and submission logic as a documented REST API with JSON endpoints.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or Smithy model exists. The only interface documentation is struts-config.xml.
findings.gap: No machine-readable specification for agent tool generation.
findings.recommendation: Generate an OpenAPI specification as part of the REST API implementation.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: The execute() method declares throws Exception with no error handling. Errors propagate as unstructured 500 responses from the container.
findings.gap: No error codes, no machine-readable error bodies, no retryable/terminal distinction.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON error responses with error codes, messages, and retryable classification.

findings.title: Non-Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: The saveApplication() method performs a raw INSERT with no idempotency key, no unique constraint, and no deduplication. Duplicate submissions create duplicate records.
findings.gap: No idempotency mechanism exists for write operations.
findings.recommendation: Add idempotency key support and unique business key constraints on write endpoints.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency mechanism
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system exposes write operations (INSERT INTO applications) with no deduplication. Agent retries would create duplicate loan records.

findings.title: HTML Response Format — Not JSON
findings.description: Responses are HTML rendered via JSP pages (/quote.jsp, /confirm.jsp). No JSON or structured data format for agent consumption.
findings.gap: Response format is HTML, not machine-consumable structured data.
findings.recommendation: Implement JSON response serialization in the new REST API.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission mechanism exists. No webhooks, SNS/EventBridge/SQS, Kafka, or CDC pipelines.
findings.gap: Loan application submissions produce no events for downstream consumers.
findings.recommendation: Consider EventBridge integration for loan application lifecycle events.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limits documented, no API Gateway throttle settings, no X-RateLimit-Remaining headers in responses.
findings.gap: Agents have no visibility into traffic limits.
findings.recommendation: Implement and document rate limits with standard headers when deploying API Gateway.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: Only container-managed human authentication via request.getRemoteUser() from WebLogic. No OAuth2 client credentials, API keys, mTLS, or service account support.
findings.gap: No machine-to-machine authentication mechanism. Agents cannot authenticate as distinct principals.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials flow or API key authentication with principal attribution.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions Model
findings.description: No scoped permissions model exists. All authenticated users receive identical access to all operations with no mechanism to differentiate access levels.
findings.gap: Cannot grant read-only access to specific resources per identity.
findings.recommendation: Implement RBAC with per-identity scoping in the new API layer.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: Only authentication check exists (getRemoteUser). No action-level authorization — any authenticated user can perform any operation.
findings.gap: Cannot restrict an agent to read operations within the same resource type.
findings.recommendation: Implement fine-grained action-level authorization (canRead, canWrite, canSubmit).

findings.title: No Identity Propagation or Delegation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism. No JWT, OAuth token exchange, or on-behalf-of flows. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: No delegation model for identity propagation through service calls.
findings.recommendation: Implement JWT-based identity propagation with on-behalf-of flow support.

findings.title: Hardcoded Database Credentials in Source Code
findings.description: Database credentials hardcoded in source: DB_USER='loan_app', DB_PASS='loanApp2010'. Committed to version control. No secrets management, no rotation.
findings.gap: Credentials in source code, no secrets management system.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation. Remove credentials from source and git history.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. Write operations have no immutable, tamper-evident trail. Cannot prove compliance or conduct forensics.
findings.gap: No audit trail for write operations. No CloudTrail, no log validation, no immutable storage.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured audit logging with principal attribution in immutable storage.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system performs write operations (loan submissions) with no audit trail. Agent actions cannot be forensically attributed.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Capability
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual agent identities. No API key revocation, no IAM role deactivation, no service account disable.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without taking down the platform.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-agent API key management with instant revocation capability.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback for Write Operations
findings.description: The saveApplication() method performs a single INSERT with no compensation logic, undo endpoints, saga pattern, or two-phase commit. Submitted applications cannot be rolled back.
findings.gap: No rollback or compensation mechanism for write operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement status-based lifecycle (PENDING → APPROVED → COMMITTED) with cancellation support.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no compensation mechanism
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write operations (loan application INSERT) are immediately final with no undo. An agent-initiated multi-step workflow cannot recover from partial failure.

findings.title: No Queryable Current State
findings.description: No queryable state endpoint exists. Only INSERT operation. No GET endpoint for application status or read-before-write pattern.
findings.gap: Agents cannot inspect current state before taking action.
findings.recommendation: Implement GET endpoints for loan application state with filtering.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No concurrency controls. No optimistic locking, version fields, ETags, or SELECT FOR UPDATE. Concurrent agents may create conflicting records.
findings.gap: No protection against race conditions from concurrent agent instances.
findings.recommendation: Implement optimistic locking with version fields and unique business key constraints.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configurations for Oracle DB dependency. Raw JDBC connection with DriverManager.getConnection() — no pooling, no timeouts.
findings.gap: Database outage causes unbounded thread blocking and cascading failure.
findings.recommendation: Implement connection pooling with circuit breaker patterns and configurable timeouts.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting at Any Layer
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway throttling, WAF rate rules, or application-level rate limiting. Agent loops could overwhelm the system.
findings.gap: No protection against agent traffic storms.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with usage plans and throttling before exposing to agents.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits. No max records per operation, no spend thresholds, no per-agent caps. Agent errors have unbounded blast radius.
findings.gap: No business-domain caps on operation scope.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable per-agent transaction limits (max_submissions_per_hour).

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State for Agent Proposals
findings.description: No draft or pending state. INSERT immediately commits to database with no reviewable intermediate state.
findings.gap: No mechanism for an agent to propose a write without immediately committing it.
findings.recommendation: Implement DRAFT → PENDING_REVIEW → APPROVED status workflow.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gate mechanism. All operations execute immediately with no human review option.
findings.gap: Cannot require human approval for high-risk agent operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates for high-value operations.

findings.title: No Proper Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No proper staging environment. Only a shared UAT environment exists with no production-equivalent staging or synthetic data.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Create containerized staging with synthetic test data for agent testing.

findings.title: Sensitive Financial PII Exposed Without Scoping
findings.description: System stores financial PII (applicant names, loan amounts, rates, officer identities). No field filtering, no response DTO separation, no access control differentiation.
findings.gap: No mechanism to scope agent-facing API responses to exclude sensitive fields.
findings.recommendation: Implement response DTOs with field-level filtering based on caller scope.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 fired (no field filtering for sensitive data)
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: DATA-Q1 B1 fired: the system stores financial PII and has no mechanism to exclude sensitive fields from agent-consumable responses.

b1.reasoning: No field filtering or response DTO separation. All sensitive data (applicant PII, financial details) would be fully exposed.

b2.reasoning: No access control differentiation — single shared auth with no role/scope granularity.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata, tags, or PII detection tooling.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls for Financial PII
findings.description: Financial PII stored in Oracle 11g with no residency controls, compliance documentation, or region-restriction policies. Agent transmission to external LLM endpoints is uncontrolled.
findings.gap: No data residency management for regulated financial data.
findings.recommendation: Document residency requirements and configure region-restriction policies.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND financial PII with no residency controls
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system stores financial PII (loan applications) with no data residency documentation or configuration. An agent sending this data to an LLM in another jurisdiction has no guardrails.

findings.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability — No Input Validation
findings.description: Critical SQL injection: applicant name concatenated directly into SQL string. No input validation, no parameterized queries for user input, no schema enforcement.
findings.gap: No input validation at any layer. SQL injection is exploitable.
findings.recommendation: Convert to parameterized queries immediately. Implement comprehensive input validation.

findings.title: No Temporal Metadata or Freshness Signaling
findings.description: No temporal metadata in data model. INSERT has no created_at/updated_at fields. No timezone handling or freshness signaling.
findings.gap: Agents cannot reason about data freshness or temporal ordering.
findings.recommendation: Add temporal metadata columns (created_at, updated_at with UTC) to all tables.

findings.title: No PII Redaction Infrastructure
findings.description: No PII redaction mechanisms. System handles financial PII with no log scrubbing, masking libraries, or redaction filters. WebLogic container logs may capture unmasked PII.
findings.gap: No PII protection mechanism for logging pipelines.
findings.recommendation: Implement PII redaction in all logging pipelines before agent exposure.

findings.title: No Data Quality Monitoring
findings.description: No data quality metrics, completeness monitoring, profiling, or freshness SLAs for the loan applications dataset.
findings.gap: Agents have no visibility into data quality.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality monitoring for loan applications.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, API contracts, changelog, or breaking change detection. No migration files, no contract tests.
findings.gap: Agent tool bindings would break silently on any change.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning and schema change detection in CI.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog, metadata layer, or schema documentation beyond the SQL INSERT columns.
findings.gap: Building agent tools requires manual discovery of data semantics.
findings.recommendation: Document the data model and register in a data catalog.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No observability infrastructure. No OpenTelemetry, X-Ray, structured logging, or correlation IDs.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated request failures cannot be debugged.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry with structured JSON logging and trace context propagation.

findings.title: No Alerting on Error Rates or Latency
findings.description: No alerting configuration. No CloudWatch alarms, anomaly detection, or operational monitoring.
findings.gap: Cannot detect system degradation before agents cascade failures.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms on API error rates and latency.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC. Manual WAR deployment via WebLogic admin console on Solaris. No Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK.
findings.gap: No IaC governance for integration surface. Changes are manual and unaudited.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure as code with PR review and drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. No GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or CodeBuild. Manual deployment.
findings.gap: No automated pipeline to detect API-breaking changes.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with automated testing and API contract validation.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No rollback capability. Manual WAR deployment with no blue/green, canary, or automated rollback.
findings.gap: Cannot quickly roll back broken deployments affecting agent APIs.
findings.recommendation: Implement blue/green deployment with automated rollback triggers.

findings.title: No Automated Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests. README confirms zero test coverage — only shared UAT environment.
findings.gap: No automated validation of API behavior for agents.
findings.recommendation: Implement comprehensive API test suites (unit + integration + contract).

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest Configuration
findings.description: No encryption at rest configuration. Oracle 11g stores financial PII with no TDE or KMS evidence in code or config.
findings.gap: Financial PII potentially unencrypted at rest.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to encrypted managed database (Amazon RDS with KMS).

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no operations >30s or long-running workflows detected.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority assigned and not identified as critical path.

evaluations.title: Selective Query Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no list/query endpoints with potentially unbounded results.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Database field names (applicant, principal, rate, term, officer) are semantically meaningful and human-readable.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry surface exists — informational signal, no finding emitted per Informational-Absence Suppression.

items.summary: Resolve all 7 BLOCKERs and address critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Focus on establishing a programmatic API, machine identity, audit logging, and write safety controls.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and foundational RISK-QUALITY findings. Build observability, deployment maturity, and data governance infrastructure.
Complete quality improvements: machine-readable specs, structured errors, test coverage, and metadata documentation.

recommended_actions.action: Build REST API with JSON endpoints to replace Struts form UI
recommended_actions.rationale: Foundational blocker — no agent integration is possible without a programmatic API.

recommended_actions.action: Implement OAuth2 machine identity with scoped permissions
recommended_actions.rationale: Agents cannot authenticate without machine identity. Identity underpins all authorization and audit decisions.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy immutable audit logging with CloudTrail
recommended_actions.rationale: Compliance requirement for write-enabled agent access to financial data.

recommended_actions.action: Implement idempotency keys and compensation/rollback patterns
recommended_actions.rationale: Agent retries and LLM non-determinism create duplicate records without idempotency. Partial failures leave corrupted state without rollback.

recommended_actions.action: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager
recommended_actions.rationale: Hardcoded production credentials in source code are an active security vulnerability.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy API Gateway with rate limiting and data residency controls
recommended_actions.rationale: Controls agent traffic storms and ensures financial PII is not transmitted across compliance boundaries.
